deadlines.label: Application due per every country specific narrative in Attachment 1 (all 10 narratives say 12pm EST on 15 May 2026)
deadlines.quote: NOTE: Application submissions for this narrative are due by 12pm EST on 15 May 2026. Submissions received after the deadline will not be considered for funding.

deadlines.label: Base announcement Section D: applications due 5:00 p.m. ET on the date in the country narrative (15 May 2026); conflicts with the narratives' 12pm EST
deadlines.quote: Submission Dates and Times: Applications must be received by 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time (ET), on the date specified in the country specific narrative in Attachment 1.

deadlines.label: Announcement closes (open continuously until 18 September 2027)
deadlines.quote: This announcement will be open to receive applications continuously until 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time (ET), 18 September 2027, at which point all applications must be received.

award.quote: The Period of Performance for these awards is 4 years.

sections.name: Cover Page
sections.quote: Cover Page - Should include the words "Technical Narrative" as well as the following:

sections.name: Project Abstract
sections.quote: Project Abstract - Concise, single-spaced abstract, not to exceed 4000 characters, summarizing the proposed program effort

sections.name: Executive Summary
sections.component: Technical Narrative: Section I: Technical Approach
sections.quote: Executive Summary (Not to exceed two pages). Brief description of proposed activities, goals, purposes, and anticipated results.

sections.name: Background Information
sections.component: Technical Narrative: Section I: Technical Approach
sections.quote: Background Information (Not to exceed two pages). Provide contextual information relevant to setting goals and technical approaches.

sections.name: Goal and Objectives
sections.component: Technical Narrative: Section I: Technical Approach
sections.quote: Goal and Objectives (Not to exceed five pages). Provide high level goals/aims of programming to include outcomes and impacts in target populations

sections.name: Work Plan
sections.component: Technical Narrative: Section I: Technical Approach
sections.quote: Work Plan (Not to exceed six pages). Provide expanded detail on activities contributing to approach and sequencing.

sections.name: Data Management Plan
sections.component: Technical Narrative: Section I: Technical Approach
sections.quote: Data Management Plan (Not to exceed two pages). Data Management Plan should include:

sections.name: Monitoring and Evaluation
sections.component: Technical Narrative: Section I: Technical Approach
sections.quote: Monitoring and Evaluation (Not to exceed five pages, inclusive of table of indicators). State how you will demonstrate that the proposed program will have an impact

sections.name: Schedule and milestones
sections.component: Technical Narrative: Section I: Technical Approach
sections.quote: Schedule and milestones (Not to exceed two pages). Provide a schedule and description of major milestones or tasks to be accomplished in the proposed program by quarter

sections.name: In-Country Participation
sections.component: Technical Narrative: Section I: Technical Approach
sections.quote: In-Country Participation (Not to exceed four pages). Describe the involvement of the host country's military and its leadership in:

sections.name: Relevance of the Program
sections.component: Technical Narrative: Section I: Technical Approach
sections.quote: Relevance of the Program (Not to exceed two pages). (a) Describe the relevance of the proposed program to the needs, priorities and circumstances of the host country's military

sections.name: Management Approach
sections.component: Technical Narrative: Section II: Management and Qualifications Approach
sections.quote: Management Approach (Not to exceed fifteen pages). The Management Plan will provide a clear description of how the cooperative agreement will be managed

sections.name: The Organization's Qualifications
sections.component: Technical Narrative: Section II: Management and Qualifications Approach
sections.quote: The Organization's Qualifications (Not to exceed five pages) - In this section, the applicant should describe its organizational knowledge, capability and experience in managing similar programs.

sections.name: Current and Pending Support
sections.component: Technical Narrative: Section II: Management and Qualifications Approach
sections.quote: Current and Pending Support (Not to exceed five pages) - The applicant must provide information on all current and pending projects

criteria.name: Technical Approach: Goals and Objectives
criteria.quote: Goals and Objectives. The proposal clearly states the overall goal(s) of the program and has specific, measurable objectives.

criteria.name: Technical Approach: Work Plan
criteria.quote: Work Plan: The proposal contains sound scientific methods, an appropriate work plan described in sufficient detail and appropriate deliverables.

criteria.name: Technical Approach: Methodology for monitoring and evaluation procedures
criteria.quote: Methodology for monitoring and evaluation procedures. The proposed plan includes a description of how the program will have an impact on the country's military

criteria.name: Technical Approach: Schedule and milestones
criteria.quote: Schedule and milestones. The proposed plan for HIV prevention efforts is feasible and contains concrete, achievable schedule and milestones.

criteria.name: Technical Approach: Relevance to the host country's military
criteria.quote: Relevance to the host country's military. The proposal clearly describes the involvement of the host country military and the relevance of the proposed program

criteria.name: Qualifications: Key Personnel
criteria.quote: b. Qualifications Key Personnel are qualified and eligible to perform the work.

criteria.name: Whether the applicant qualifies as a local partner (unscored)
criteria.quote: In addition, the following unscored criteria will also contribute to the overall evaluation of the application: Whether the applicant qualifies as a local partner.

other: Technical Narrative not to exceed 45 pages; pages beyond any "Not to exceed" limit are deleted before review
All proposals and documents must be in English or they will be rejected
Project abstract over 4000 characters is withdrawn/rejected; standard QWERTY characters only, spell out Greek letters and symbols, no graphics
Project abstract must contain no proprietary or confidential information and be marked "Approved for Public Release"
Mark each page of the submission that contains proprietary information
Do not include classified national security information
Cover Page must include funding opportunity number, targeted country, title, prime respondent and subcontractors, technical and administrative contacts, duration of effort, and a table of contents
format.quote: Font: Times New Roman, 12 point Margins: 1 inch on all sides Paper size: 8 ½ by 11" Single-spaced

eligibility.item: Responsible sources from academia, industry, and non-governmental organizations are eligible
eligibility.quote: Eligible Applicants: All responsible sources from academia, industry, and non- governmental organizations may submit proposals under this announcement.

eligibility.item: No award may be made directly to a foreign military establishment
eligibility.quote: No grants, contracts or cooperative agreements may be awarded directly to foreign military establishments.

eligibility.item: Demonstrate the active support of the in-country military and the DoW representative at the U.S. Embassy in planning and submitting the proposal
eligibility.quote: All respondents must demonstrate the active support of the in-country military and the DoW representative in the corresponding U.S. Embassy in the planning and submission of their proposals.

eligibility.item: Proposals must be submitted through Grants.gov
eligibility.quote: DoW will only accept proposals submitted through Grants.gov on or before the date specified in the country specific narrative provided in Attachment 1.

eligibility.item: Organization must have a UEI, an active SAM registration, and a Grants.gov account
eligibility.quote: Organizations must have a Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) Number, active System for Award Management (SAM) registration, and Grants.gov account to apply for grants.

eligibility.item: SAM registration must show "Active" status before submitting through Grants.gov
eligibility.quote: receive confirmation of an "Active" status before submitting an application through Grants.gov.

eligibility.item: Submitter must hold the Grants.gov AOR role authorized by the organization's EBiz POC
eligibility.quote: You will be able to submit your application online any time after you have been assigned the AOR role.

eligibility.item: Institutions of higher education must certify compliance with 10 U.S.C. 983 and 32 C.F.R. 216 (ROTC and military recruiting access)
eligibility.quote: Institutions of higher education must certify compliance with 10 U.S.C 983, Institutions Of Higher Education That Prevent ROTC Access Or Military Recruiting On Campus

eligibility.item: Applicant must not require employees, contractors, or subrecipients to sign confidentiality agreements that restrict lawful reporting of fraud, waste, or abuse
eligibility.quote: Recipient will not require any of its employees, contractors, or sub- recipients seeking to report fraud, waste, or abuse to sign or comply with internal confidentiality agreements

eligibility.item: A corporation with unpaid assessed federal tax liability or a federal felony conviction in the preceding 24 months is ineligible unless the suspension and debarment official clears it
eligibility.quote: the applicant is ineligible to receive an award unless the agency suspension and debarment official has considered suspension or debarment and determined that further action is not required

eligibility.item: Investigators on collaborative projects should each write and submit a separate proposal naming the collaborator's proposal
eligibility.quote: Investigators on collaborative projects should each write and submit separate, unique proposals, and provide the name and title of their collaborator's proposal within the project narrative of the application.

eligibility.item: Funds will not support scientists from countries designated as State Sponsors of Terrorism
eligibility.quote: The Federal Government will not provide funds to support scientists from countries meeting the criteria for designation as a State Sponsor of Terrorism

eligibility.item: Multi-country SABERS narrative only: respondents must demonstrate previous experience designing, managing, and implementing epidemiological research and surveillance
eligibility.quote: All respondents must demonstrate previous experience in the design, management, and implementation of epidemiological research and surveillance.

requiredDocuments.item: SF-424 Research and Related, Application for Federal Assistance (cover page of the proposal)
requiredDocuments.quote: SF-424 Research and Related, Application for Federal Assistance - (included in the application package available on grants.gov posted with this Program Announcement).

requiredDocuments.item: SF-424 Research and Related Budget, one submission per budget year
requiredDocuments.quote: SF-424 Research and Related Budget - included in the application package available on grants.gov posted with this Program Announcement. Please ensure there is a submission for each budget year.

requiredDocuments.item: Budget Narrative Attachment Form with the budget justification
requiredDocuments.quote: Budget Narrative Attachment Form - Attach the Budget justification the SF424 R&R as required under Section L of the SF424 (R&R) form.
SF-424B, Assurances - Nonconstruction Programs - (included in the application package available on grants.gov posted with this Program Announcement).

requiredDocuments.item: Statement of Work (SOW) file in the program office's Excel workbook, summarizing planned activities per program area for each year
requiredDocuments.quote: Statement of Work (SOW) File: Proposals must include a supplementary document for Statement of Work. In the Excel workbook provided by the program office

requiredDocuments.item: Milestone metrics table mapping each activity to its milestone, outcome or process metric, and budget (country narratives)
requiredDocuments.quote: All proposals must include milestone metrics by activity and which outcome or process metric each activity supports.

requiredDocuments.item: Letter of support from the in-country military (country narratives)
requiredDocuments.quote: All respondents must demonstrate the active support of the in-country military in the planning and execution of their proposals. This should be done by attaching an appropriate letter of support.

requiredDocuments.item: Letters of support from all stakeholders mentioned in In-Country Participation, as addendums
requiredDocuments.quote: (*Letters of support from all stakeholders mentioned should be included as addendums to the proposal).

requiredDocuments.item: MOUs with proposed partners where existing relationships exist, in the Attachment/Annex
requiredDocuments.quote: Applicant should state whether or not they have any existing relationships with the proposed partners and, if so, should include the Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs) in the Attachment/Annex.

requiredDocuments.item: Representations Regarding Unpaid Federal Tax Liabilities and Felony Convictions form (from eBRAP), uploaded under Attachments
requiredDocuments.quote: The form for completion and submission is posted in eBRAP (https://ebrap.org/eBRAP/public/Program.htm). Upload the form into Grants.gov under Attachments.

requiredDocuments.item: SF LLL Disclosure of Lobbying Activities, if applicable, attached to Block 18 of the SF 424
requiredDocuments.quote: Complete SFLLL (Disclosure of Lobbying Activities), if applicable, and attach to Block 18 of the SF424 (Application for Federal Assistance) Form.

requiredDocuments.item: Supporting documentation of local partner status, if claiming it
requiredDocuments.quote: To be considered a local partner, the applicant must submit supporting documentation demonstrating their organization meets at least one of the criteria listed below at the time of application.
